feeds.intro: Subscribe to this household's chores from Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook. Feeds are read-only.
feeds.once: Copy it now. Anyone with this address can see chore names and dates, and it can't be shown again. Regenerate or revoke it if it leaks.

household.defaultReminderHint: Used by chores that don't pick their own.
household.areasEnabledHint: Adds an area to each chore, area filters on the home screen and area labels in calendar feeds. Existing areas are kept when you turn this off.
transfer.title: Export and import
transfer.intro: Back up or move this household as a JSON file. It holds chores, areas, settings and history, but never notification addresses, calendar links or tokens. An owner's file also lists the household's webhook addresses (never their signing secrets); those addresses can contain credentials, so keep the file private.
transfer.fileHint: A Gunkly household export (.json), up to 5 MB.
transfer.modeNew: A new household (you become its owner)
transfer.modeMergeHint: Areas with the same name are combined and chores are added as new chores. Assignees who aren't members of this household become “anyone”.
transfer.tooLarge: That file is larger than 5 MB.
transfer.sumWebhooks: Webhooks added: {count}. They are switched off with new signing secrets: review each one, then use “New secret” and turn it on.
transfer.whReason.webhooks_disabled: webhooks are switched off on this server
transfer.sumUnassigned: Chores now set to “anyone” because their assignees aren't members here: {count}
import.err.not_json: That file can't be read. Choose a Gunkly household export (.json).
import.err.format: That isn't a Gunkly household export file.
import.err.version: That file was made by a different version of Gunkly and can't be imported.
import.err.limit_chores: The file has more chores than this household may have.
import.err.limit_areas: The file has more areas than this household may have.
import.err.limit_reminders: A chore in the file has more reminders than allowed.
import.err.limit_completions: The file has more history entries than allowed.
household.leaveOwnerWarn: You are the only owner. Pick the member who takes over before you leave.
household.leaveDeleteWarn: You are the last member who can use this household. Leaving will permanently delete it with all its chores.
channels.householdIntro: Add a household channel, such as your family Telegram or Discord group, and reminders go to everyone in the household without anyone having to set anything up.
webhook.title: Webhooks (advanced)
webhook.intro: Gunkly sends a signed message to a web address when something happens to a chore, for example to a home automation system or your own script. Only add addresses you trust.
webhook.urlHint: Must start with https://. Treat it as a secret: it is never shown again, only its host.
webhook.events: Send a message when a chore is
webhook.invalidUrl: That address is not allowed. Use a public https:// address.
webhook.secretOnce: Copy it now. For security it can not be shown again. Use it to check that messages really come from Gunkly.
webhook.verifyHint: Sign "t.body" (the timestamp from the Gunkly-Signature header, a dot, the raw body) with HMAC-SHA256 using the secret and compare it with the v1 value. Reject timestamps more than 5 minutes old. Details in docs/webhooks.md.
webhook.autoOff: Switched off after 20 failed attempts in a row. Check the address, then turn it on again.
webhook.rotateWarn: The old secret stops working at once. Update whatever checks the messages with the new one.
webhook.deleteWarn: Gunkly stops sending to it and its log is deleted.

welcome.title: Welcome to Gunkly
welcome.intro: Let's set up your home in a minute. You can change everything later.
welcome.verifyBody: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm the address; this also turns on two-step verification for your account.
welcome.verifyHint: Once confirmed, this page moves on by itself. No email? Check your spam folder, or send the link again.
welcome.householdHint: A household is the home you share chores in. You can invite the people you live with in a moment.
welcome.areas: Group chores by area (kitchen, bathroom, garden and more)
welcome.choresTitle: Pick a few chores to start with
welcome.choresHint: Common ones are already ticked. Their first dates are spread over the coming week, so not everything is due today.
welcome.inviteHint: Share chores with the people you live with: send them an invite link. You can also do this later under Settings, People.
welcome.shareText: Join {household} on Gunkly to share our chores:
welcome.secureHintEmail: You already get a code by email when you sign in. A passkey (your fingerprint, face or device PIN) is quicker and safer, and an authenticator app works without email. Recommended, but you can skip this.
welcome.secureHint: Add a second step to signing in, so a password alone is not enough: a passkey (your fingerprint, face or device PIN) or an authenticator app. Recommended, but you can skip this.
welcome.secureLater: You can do this any time later under Settings, Sign-in & security.
welcome.introAgain: Go through the setup again: pick a household, add starter chores, invite someone and secure your account. Every step can be skipped.
